## Purpose

Retain the ordinary context_packet answer-table sample as a static transport-shape witness.

## Code Commentary

The literal compact packet contains roots, serving-build and pair values; the leaf-shaped sample also carries task identity. These recorded identities and log locations belong to the fixture epoch, not the live workspace.

The answer-table tests consume these exact fixture bytes. Production versus recorded provenance and regeneration belong to PROVENANCE.md and the test producer, not manual edits of identities, tokens or output counts. No secret or current operational credential is represented by these static values.
